# Trello MCP

Atlassian's official Trello MCP server lets agents work with Trello boards, lists, cards, the member Inbox, and Planner while respecting the connected user's Trello permissions.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/trello-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Trelloreadboard** (read-only): Read Trello boards.
- **Trelloreadcard** (read-only): Fetch a Trello card's full details, or list cards across a board or list to surface open work items.
- **Trelloreadchecklist** (read-only): Read Trello checklists (and their check items) attached to a card.
- **Trelloreadinbox** (read-only): Triage and review the authenticated user's Trello Inbox — the personal quick-capture board where new cards and notifications land.
- **Trelloreadlist** (read-only): Read Trello lists.
- **Trelloreadmember** (read-only): Get a Trello member's profile.
- **Trelloreadplanner** (read-only): Read Trello Planner information for the authenticated user.
- **Trelloreadworkspace** (read-only): Read Trello workspaces (organizations) the current user has access to.
- **Trellosearch** (read-only): Discover Trello boards or cards by keyword across all workspaces.
- **Trellowriteboard**: Create Trello boards.
- **Trellowritecard**: Create, update, move, archive, mark Trello cards done, or manage labels on cards.
- **Trellowritechecklist**: Write Trello checklists and their check items.
- **Trellowriteinbox**: Write Trello Inbox cards.
- **Trellowritelist**: Create, update, archive, or move a Trello list.
- **Trellowriteplanner**: Create Trello Planner calendar events and manage card-event links.
